brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.evidence: 2-level structure (piece:0,0,0;full + piece:0,0,1;full with adjacent half-w supports) topped with covers (cover:0,0,1;full;top, cover:0,1,1;half-w;top, cover:1,0,1;half-w;top) providing flat shelf surface; meshClash clear.
Hex Cluster checks fit/mesh only and does not claim load ratings per brief rules. Build provides structural levels and joint bolts but no verified 50 kg load certification exists in configurator.
Two notch drawer frames installed: notch:0#-1,1#notch0 (level 0) and notch:1#-1,1#notch0 (level 1), each in empty cell between adjacent bases.

finish.summary: Built compact 2-high shelf with top covers as shelf surface and two notch drawers (one per level). Mesh is clear; only informational open-cap faces remain. Cannot verify 50 kg rating as system does not rate loads.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
